rule: Demands guide Money Flow Map and public-income engines. No tax abolition. Unmodeled returns are not replacement dollars. Zero counted until cash-flow model. External income is not automatically public revenue. Gross outside revenue ≠ Arkansas capture (EICR). Residual Wealth Contribution is the last compulsory shock absorber — beneficial ownership, universal NW floor, never ordinary labor income. Theoretical wealth base ≠ effective base. Residual Progressive IIT (UPD-145) is superseded. Illustrative yields/feeders are not countable. Unrealized gains are not tax-retirement credit. No principal or existing-obligation raids. Illiquidity is collection timing not exemption. PUBLIC_RISK_AT_RISK required on Value Capture/Enterprise. No discriminatory export taxes. HYP-130 capacity gates External Income scale claims. Retire millage-class by millage-class.

demands.name: dfa_comprehensive_state_revenue_inventory
demands.question: What is the complete Arkansas DFA state revenue inventory by source and fiscal year (including IIT, sales/use, corporate, severance, gaming, and dedications), with primary tables bound?

demands.name: local_millage_and_property_tax_inventory
demands.question: What are total property-tax collections and millages by beneficiary class (schools, counties, cities, fire/EMS, libraries, roads, debt, pensions) statewide and for designated Living Systems counties?

demands.name: constitutional_statutory_dependency_matrix
demands.question: Which revenue streams are constitutionally required (esp. 25-mill URT), which are statutory, and which expenditures cannot lawfully be uncoupled from those sources without amendment?

demands.name: school_foundation_funding_bind
demands.question: Can the ~$1.603B URT local foundation funding estimate for 2024–25 be bound to the BLR Funding Overview primary tables and reconciled to ADE/DFA series?

demands.name: incidence_analysis_iit_sales_property
demands.question: Who actually bears Arkansas IIT, sales/use, and property taxes by income quintile, housing tenure, and geography?

demands.name: replacement_candidate_five_tests
demands.question: For each Resource + Enterprise + Consumption candidate, what are T1–T5 scores (capacity, volatility, incidence, prosperity alignment, behavioral distortion) with sourced magnitudes — without assuming sufficiency?

demands.name: tax_retirement_fund_design
demands.question: What legal/administrative design ring-fences replacement dollars into a Tax Retirement Fund with automatic safety-threshold reductions?

demands.name: community_prosperity_revenue_pilots
demands.question: Which local replacement classes (energy, broadband, value capture, enterprise ownership, equalization) can be piloted under existing law before constitutional URT redesign?

demands.name: volatility_series_commodity_tourism_gaming
demands.question: How volatile are severance, energy, tourism, and gaming revenues across recessions and commodity cycles relative to IIT?

demands.name: prosperity_fund_and_public_returns_modeling
demands.question: Under what assumptions could prosperity-fund dividends or public investment returns become material replacement dollars — and what is the honest timeline before they count?

demands.name: equalization_transfer_design
demands.question: If local property-tax retirement proceeds unevenly, what state equalization design prevents school/service collapse in low-base communities?

demands.name: money_flow_map_row_population
demands.question: Can every material Arkansas revenue source carry the full row schema (source → dollars → beneficiary → dependency → volatility → incidence → replacement → maturity → trigger)?

demands.name: school_debt_service_millage_split
demands.question: What statewide dollars sit in school debt-service millages versus additional M&O above URT?
demands.note: ~93.7% of non-URT school mills are debt; preferred debt ~$945M; additional M&O ~$64M. District-AV-weighted still NEE.

demands.name: municipal_av_weighted_collections
demands.question: What are AV-weighted municipal property-tax collections (not average city millage × statewide AV)?

demands.name: prosperity_linked_and_productive_wealth_cashflows
demands.question: For prosperity-linked revenue and productive public wealth, which assets, capital requirements, return/volatility assumptions, and years-to-scale are required before material incremental replacement dollars exist?

demands.name: renter_economic_incidence
demands.question: What share of residential property tax is economically borne by renters through rents in Arkansas markets?

demands.name: ten_public_income_engines_architecture
demands.question: Can HYP-131 specify ten public-income engines (Use, Impact, Depletion, Visitor, Luxury, Human-capital, Value Capture, Enterprise, Prosperity Fund, External Income) with constitutional guardrails and a zero-count-until-cashflow rule?

demands.name: use_and_depletion_incremental_cashflows
demands.question: What incremental Use and Depletion cash flows (beyond already-earmarked fuel/severance) are legally available and stress-tested?
demands.note: Fuel ~$572M and gas severance ~$26M bound; already spent / volatile. COUNTABLE NOW $0.

demands.name: workforce_prosperity_contribution_incidence
demands.question: For a Workforce Prosperity Contribution, what is the incidence on workers, consumers, and shareholders under alternative bases and credit designs?
demands.note: Six bases + credit model mapped; QCEW wages ~$64.5B bound; Arkansas-specific pass-through and credit leakage still NEE. COUNTABLE NOW $0.

demands.name: value_capture_and_enterprise_incremental_cashflows
demands.question: Which Value Capture and Enterprise candidates clear capital→debt→O&M→net→legal→stress gates as truly incremental recurring public income, with PUBLIC_RISK_AT_RISK aligned to upside?
demands.note: 15 candidates scored; COUNTABLE NOW $0. Plausible: participation redesign, ground leases, ports/parks, energy/broadband/IP. Not material: TIF, airports, conduit IDBs, water/housing raids.

demands.name: prosperity_fund_capital_path
demands.question: What corpus, contribution feeders, return assumptions, payout rule, and years-to-scale are required before Prosperity Fund payouts can count toward IIT/property replacement?
demands.note: 4% markers $6.25B–$50B; Base ~y11 for $250M if feeders real; $2B outside 16y; COUNTABLE NOW $0.

demands.name: wpc_size_class_and_credit_leakage
demands.question: What share of Arkansas private wages sits above large-employer thresholds, and what net cash remains after verified workforce credits at 30/60/90% uptake?

demands.name: external_income_sector_capture
demands.question: Which External Income sectors can pull outside dollars into Arkansas with public/community capture that feeds Enterprise and the Prosperity Fund — and what share remains after leakage?
demands.note: 12 sectors scored; tourism spend ~$10.2B bound; EICR modeling tool; hard wall holds; HYP-130 linked; COUNTABLE $0. Next: Replacement Stack integration.

demands.name: public_income_replacement_stack
demands.question: Integrating all 10 engines plus the effective residual wealth base, how much of personal income tax and property tax can Arkansas realistically retire on 4/8/12/16-year timelines under stress and optimistic cases?

demands.name: residual_progressive_income_tax_top_down
demands.question: If other engines cover $X of the ~$3.859B IIT, how high can the residual progressive income-tax starting point rise, and how far down the SOI distribution must a residual gap of $250M–$3B reach under marginal schedules?
demands.note: SUPERSEDED by CC-DEM-RRR-025 / CC-DEC-133. Residual instrument is wealth contribution, not residual IIT. Ledger retained for history.

demands.name: residual_wealth_contribution
demands.question: How much revenue can Arkansas raise from households with very high net worth while fully exempting ordinary homes, retirement security, working farms/small businesses below a protected threshold, and everyone dependent primarily on labor income — and for residual gaps of $250M/$500M/$1B/$2B, what minimum wealth threshold and rate close the gap?
demands.note: Revised by CC-DEM-RRR-026: protection design is universal floor + collection timing, not asset-menu exemptions. IRS 2019 AR top wealth ≥$11.4M remains the bound observation.

demands.name: residual_wealth_no_loopholes_base_and_legal
demands.question: Can Arkansas define substantial surplus wealth broadly enough that economically equivalent wealth is treated equivalently regardless of legal wrapper, while remaining administrable, constitutional, and resistant to avoidance — and what effective-base percentage remains after valuation, migration, restructuring, preemption, collection lag, and compliance costs?
demands.note: Beneficial ownership + universal floor + illiquidity-as-collection. Base haircut ~57% retention → ~$27.7B / 1%≈$277M. Legal tracks open; floors not locked; not countable.
